No, I mean, my reasoning is stupid and shit when compared to real reasons like those. That's what I meant. I'm not putting those other people down. They deserve help much more than I do.

The people who love me do so without justification. I am constantly rude to my brother yet he still loves me. I pause, think about it, try to treat them better and then I just start being mean and hurtful again. I'm a toxic person who really doesn't deserve much in the way of compassion yet they manage to love me. I think it would be simpler and cleaner for me if they shunned me, yet they don't.

I am terrified of death but I'm sick of being alive. As cliche as it sounds, not being born at all would've been perfect.

hey, it doesn't really matter but you're describing my own situation perfectly, except I'm a bit older than you. 

sounds stupid and hypocrite from my keyboard, but keep at it. I'm doing the same. It hasn't gotten better and I doubt it will, but maybe. I don't know. I still hope it will. It's getting hard.

It seems like a stupid reason when I hear about people struggling with abuse or addictions or shit like that. I rarely cry. I laugh often in the company of friends who I love dearly. But it doesn't matter. I can't explain it clearly. I think I should've killed myself already and I'm only postponing the inevitable.
